newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Esso Singapore says refinery back to normal output.
newsitem.headline: Esso Singapore says refinery back to normal output.

text.p: Esso Singapore said on Tuesday that its refinery was operating at normal capacity of 230,000 barrels per day (bpd).
A spokeswoman said the 110,000 bpd crude distillation unit (CDU) came back up from scheduled three-week maintenance on October 23 and a previously announced run cut of 15 percent had been stopped.
Esso cut runs in early July due to poor refinery margins.
Esso was the last refinery to cancel its run cuts after the Mobil Singapore 280,000 bpd refinery and Shell Singapore's 435,000 bpd refinery had temporarily also cut runs because of weak margins.
The CDU was brought down for scheduled maintenance in the week ending Friday October 11. At that time, Esso said the maintenance period would last for three weeks.
